title: Totem messages expansion
description: A datapack that adds messages whenever you use a totem of undying except that now a custom message is added for every single death
body:
This datapack adds a LOT of messages for when you die with a totem of undying ( 29 messages )

# Pluses🛢️

————————————————————————————————————————————
1) Message for most unique deaths when you are holding a totem of undying
2) In messages u will have a yellow † before the message
3) Messages are unique and you can customize them in the files
4) Used for servers that often use totems
5) If your totem has a name itll use its name in the message
# Customisability

————————————————————————————————————————————

To customize messages extract the file, go into data function and base.mcfunction
Everything you find there is the messages %1$s is basically a player that holds the totem and the other is the totems name. §e is color yellow basically and §r is normal
